test: src/lib/regex-source-guard.pass4.test.ts (4 tests); src/lib/thunai/injection.test.ts new describe (Tamil 'type' with a space failed before)
root_cause: guard: any RegExp(...) built from a plain string or template whose source text holds a single backslash turns backslash-b into a backspace and backslash-s into the letter s. The new guard found two real cases in src/lib/thunai/injection.ts (type rule: fill(?:s+in)? and the Tamil type word followed by s*; undo rule: the Tamil go-back word followed by s*), so a spoken space between those words never matched
fix: source guard (a walk with the TypeScript parser over every RegExp call; String.raw is exempt) plus a check that no file under src holds byte 0x08 except images and fonts; the two rules in injection.ts now double the backslash. A bundle-level test was not added: the source guard covers the same mistake before the build
